item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find convincing evidence that Tshisekedi genuinely tolerated robust opposition victories, sustained criticism, satirical speech, investigative journalism, protest, or civil-society monitoring in 2024. The strongest pro items are procedural and limited: some opposition seats remained, and some protests occurred. The stronger and more consistent evidence is repression, selective detention, and protest suppression.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2025: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2025","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW says authorities cracked down on opposition members, activists, critics, and journalists throughout 2024, used excessive force against a Kinshasa opposition protest, and arrested or targeted critics online and offline. This is the strongest single summary of the year’s repression pattern.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8","3B.6","3B.4"]},{"title":"DR Congo: Authorities must immediately free detained journalist","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/drc-authorities-must-immediately-free-detained-journalist/","summary":"Stanis Bujakera’s detention was described as judicial harassment meant to chill other journalists and free voices, with Amnesty explicitly calling on Tshisekedi’s government to ensure media freedom. This is direct evidence against tolerating investigative journalism or criticism.","question_ids":["4B.3","3B.8","3B.6","3B.4"]},{"title":"DR Congo’s arrest of activists invokes déjà vu of growing repression","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/dr-congos-arrest-of-activists-invokes-deja-vu-of-growing-repression/","summary":"Security services arrested LUCHA activists in a manner resembling abduction, held some in unknown detention, and used threats and violence. This is direct evidence that peaceful civil-society monitoring and criticism were not being tolerated.","question_ids":["4B.3","3B.8","3B.6","3B.4"]},{"title":"DR Congo opposition calls for the release of political prisoners at protest","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-09-25","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/protesters-congo-call-release-political-174024342.html","summary":"Hundreds protested for political prisoners, and opposition parties accused Tshisekedi of trying to muzzle opponents and silence dissenting voices. The protest itself shows opposition criticism remained visible, but the need for it is evidence of repression rather than tolerance.","question_ids":["4B.3","3B.8","3B.6"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW says police used excessive force to break up peaceful opposition demonstrations, and authorities targeted artists, journalists, and opposition members online and on social media. This is only weak positive evidence, because the same report also notes fraud allegations and transparency concerns.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.1"]},{"title":"Congo’s election commission cancels 82 candidates in disputed December polling","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-07","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congos-election-commission-cancels-82-candidates-in-disputed-december-polling/1913556/","summary":"The election commission canceled votes for 82 legislative candidates over alleged fraud and related issues. Government defense of the poll is a weak pro-formalism signal, but the dominant signal is a disputed and manipulated environment, not a tolerant one.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","4B.1"]}]}
